snippet.title: Rogue Vector - Starships with Momentum || Demo Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Every ship moves at once. Your momentum carries between turns. And once you commit your orders, there’s no taking them back.

Play the free demo: https://chaostheorygames.itch.io/rogue-vector

Rogue Vector is a sci-fi roguelike deckbuilder built around momentum-based tactical combat. Command a lone starship, assemble sequences of attacks and manoeuvres, and predict where the entire battle will be when your orders resolve.

Build momentum. Break the enemy formation. Create a fleet-killing warship from 40 cards, 20 relics, and 3 distinct ships.

You cannot outgun the armada. You’ll need to outfly them.
